NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and provides free and unlimited onboarding, training, and support. NinjaOne is #1 on G2 in endpoint management, patch management, remote monitoring and management, and mobile device management.

Growth. We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Women, and 99Families.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.

title: Técnico em Meio Ambiente - Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Por meio deste edital, a AVSI Brasil lança a seleção de um profissional para função de Técnico em Meio Ambiente. O profissional será inserido em projeto de eficiência energética, cuja lógica é a de troca de resíduos recicláveis por bônus na fatura de energia elétrica. Tal iniciativa considera a educação ambiental, por meio da reciclagem, como elemento fundamentador da construção de uma sociedade com maior responsabilidade social e ambiental.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O profissional terá como responsabilidade principal a elaboração de Estudos de Viabilidade Técnica - EVT, emissão e controle de Manifesto de Transporte de Resíduos - MTR, processamento de dados e emissão de relatórios. Além disso, fornecerá suporte abrangente às atividades do projeto, auxiliando o Supervisor de Operação nas rotinas de monitoramento dos pontos de coleta fixos e itinerantes, e deverá apoiar o Coordenador do projeto no acompanhamento das atividades e metas gerais.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  1. Produzir Estudo de Viabilidade Técnica (EVT) relacionado ao gerenciamento de resíduos recicláveis;
  2. Identificar e contatar potenciais clientes, especialmente grandes geradores de resíduos, em busca de novas parcerias;
  3. Produzir Estudo de Viabilidade Técnica - EVT, para avaliação de novos parceiros e abertura de ecopontos, bem como emitir e controlar os MTR - Manifesto de Transporte de Resíduos, produzidos pelos ecopontos;
  4. Manter contato e relacionamento proativo com os clientes do projeto;
  5. Aumentar o nível qualitativo das coletas dos grandes geradores por meio da execução de assistências técnicas, treinamentos e palestras sobre melhores práticas de gerenciamento de resíduos;
  6. Identificar e promover o tratamento de eventuais não conformidades;
  7. Alimentar os indicadores do projeto e emitir relatórios periódicos de desempenho;
  8. Auxiliar e prestar suporte operacional sempre que necessário ao Supervisor de Operações.

Fornecer suporte jurídico abrangente, proativo e autônomo a todas as áreas internas (exceto Vendas), atuando como ponto central para questões consultivas, contratuais e legais .

Atuar como facilitador na resolução de disputas pré-judiciais, garantindo continuidade e eficiência nas operações.

Gestão Estratégica e Análise Crítica de Contratos :

Desenvolver e implementar metodologias robustas para análise de contratos, com foco em identificar riscos, oportunidades e contingências contratuais.

Atuar estrategicamente na negociação de contratos, antecipando possíveis conflitos e garantindo a continuidade dos negócios, inclusive em cenários críticos ou de alta complexidade.

Coordenar a interação com as áreas operacionais e executivas, assegurando a adequação jurídica de contratos de grande impacto financeiro e operacional.

Garantir a implementação de controles de contratos para fins de Auditoria.

Garantia de Conformidade com LGPD e Normas de Privacidade

Liderar e garantir a implementação de práticas jurídicas alinhadas à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD) e às normas de privacidade aplicáveis.

Desenvolver políticas, procedimentos e treinamentos internos para assegurar a conformidade contínua com as legislações vigentes.

Monitorar e auditar processos internos para mitigar riscos relacionados a privacidade, segurança de dados e governança corporativa.

Gestão ativa de Data Process Agreements (DTAs).

Coordenar junto com fornecedor global, reportar e alinhar diretamente com o time Central de Privacidade, matérias relacionadas à Privacidade.

Coordenar Consultora de Privacidade externa, fomentando o avanço na jornada de privacidade.

Coordenar a gestão dos processos administrativos regulatórios com alinhamento com escritórios externos, preparando defesas administrativas de natureza regulatória, relacionadas aos órgãos envolvidos, no que diz respeito ao peso e à qualidade do produto, buscando a segmentação técnica junto às áreas pertinentes.

Conduzir pesquisas para identificar tendências, padrões e soluções para questões específicas.

Manter-se atualizado sobre mudanças na legislação e jurisprudências que possam afetar o negócio da companhia.

Desenvolver e implementar processos de governança jurídica, assegurando a organização, controle e atualização contínua dos documentos legais e contratuais.

Cultivar um relacionamento próximo com todas as áreas da empresa, atuando como líder estratégico no suporte jurídico para decisões de negócios em todas as matérias contratuais.

Na JDE Peet's , acreditamos que é incrível o que acontece ao redor de uma xícara de café e de chá. Também acreditamos que uma cultura diversa e inclusiva nos permite servir a todos os amantes de café e chá da melhor maneira possível.

Na JDE Peet's, nosso propósito é criar um futuro melhor, no qual servimos, refletimos e abraçamos todos em suas autenticidades. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description:
About Avra

Avra is a deep tech data intelligence platform powered by foundational AI that translates the complexity of SMEs into strategic decisions for large enterprises. We develop our own foundational models from the ground up—without relying on third-party solutions—to deliver innovative insights that empower some of the leading banks and fintechs across Latin America. Founded in 2024 by Bruno Alano (ex-OpenAI) and Viviane Meister, our team brings together expertise from NVIDIA, Palantir, Google, and more to drive real impact.

About the Role

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer at Avra, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the infrastructure that powers our AI platform. You will play a crucial role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of our systems as we process vast amounts of data and deliver real-time insights. Working closely with our engineering and data science teams, you will create resilient infrastructure that supports our heterogeneous graph neural networks and knowledge graph processing capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Platform Reliability : Design and implement highly available, fault-tolerant systems across our multi-cloud environment (AWS and GCP) that support our graph processing and AI inference workloads.

  • Kubernetes Platform Engineering : Design, implement, and maintain our production Kubernetes environments on GKE and AWS, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security for our graph processing and AI inference workloads.

  • Observability & Monitoring : Develop comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and logging systems to ensure 99.9%+ uptime for critical services and provide visibility into system performance.

  • Infrastructure as Code : Create and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform to automate provisioning and configuration management.

  • Performance Optimization : Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in our distributed systems, particularly around graph processing and real-time inference workflows.

  • Security Engineering : Collaborate with security teams to implement robust security practices, supporting our ISO 27001 and NIST CSF 2.0 certification efforts.

  • CI/CD Pipeline Enhancement : Improve and maintain our continuous integration and deployment pipelines to support rapid, reliable software delivery.

  • Incident Response : Lead incident response efforts, conduct post-mortems, and implement systems to prevent recurrence of issues.

You Stand Out If

  • You have experience building and maintaining infrastructure for data-intensive or AI applications, particularly those involving graph processing or machine learning.

  • You have DEEP expertise with Kubernetes, including advanced concepts such as custom controllers, operators, networking policies, and multi-cluster management.

  • You excel at designing scalable, distributed systems that can handle terabytes of data and millions of requests.

  • You are proficient with cloud orchestration tools like Kubernetes and have experience managing deployments across AWS and GCP environments.

  • You have significant experience with GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine) and EKS (Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service) in production environments.

  • You have implemented robust observability solutions and can effectively troubleshoot complex system failures.

  • You practice a security-first mindset and have experience implementing infrastructure security controls.

  • You are passionate about automation and eliminating toil through effective tooling.

Qualifications

  • Experience : 5+ years in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering roles, with at least 3 years of hands-on Kubernetes experience in production environments.

  • Kubernetes Expertise : Proven experience managing Kubernetes at scale, including cluster architecture, security hardening, resource optimization, and upgrade management.

  • Technical Skills : Proficiency in programming (Go, Python, or similar), cloud platforms (AWS, GCP), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and monitoring technologies (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, etc.).

  • System Design : Strong understanding of distributed systems design, failure modes, and mitigation strategies.

  • Problem-Solving : Exceptional debugging skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex issues across the entire technology stack.

  • Collaboration : Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams in a remote environment.

Why Join Avra?

  • Cutting-Edge Technology : Build infrastructure for a deep tech AI platform that processes data from millions of Brazilian companies to enable better business decisions.

  • Competitive Compensation : Attractive salary, equity participation, and full transparency in our compensation structure.

  • Direct Impact : Work closely with the founders to shape the infrastructure vision of a fast-growing startup.

  • Technical Challenges : Solve complex problems around graph processing, real-time inference, and large-scale data systems.

  • Flexible Work Culture : Enjoy the benefits of 100% remote work with access to an office in São Paulo, unlimited vacation, and a comprehensive benefits package including a national health plan and generous parental leave.

If you are passionate about building reliable, scalable infrastructure for AI systems and want to help us revolutionize how businesses make decisions about SMEs in Brazil, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to join Avra and help us build the future of AI-powered business intelligence in Latin America.

title: Sourcing Recruiter , Brazil Corporate Stores Recruiting
description:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and motivated people. As a Sourcing Recruiter, you will cultivate talent sourcing channels, develop relationships with hiring managers, and close searches against tight deadlines. In this role, you will be responsible for talent attraction strategies and utilize your experience setting benchmarks and metrics.


We need a talented Sourcing Recruiter to help us find the best talent in the world to support our growth. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers. The Sourcing Recruiter will work with a team of peers including Recruiting Business Partners and Recruiting Coordinators focusing in the areas of candidate talent search and placement, process improvement and strategy development. They will foster a collaborative team environment and a strong service-oriented culture that ensures delivery of efficient, effective, quality driven service to internal customers and meets customer service level agreements.


The Ideal candidate must be able to successfully manage, prioritize and close searches against a timeline and have experience setting benchmarks, metrics, and understand how to prioritize to hit all customer SLAs. They thrive in an innovative, fast-paced environment, can roll up their sleeves, work hard, have fun, and get the job done. The best candidates will draw on knowledge of Talent Acquisition and functional areas of the business, forging dynamic relationships with business leaders, hiring managers and HR business partners. They have a reputation for being exceptional at candidate generation, organization, possess strong verbal and written communication skills, have an ability to prioritize their time, demonstrate push back and a sense of urgency, and value providing amazing customer service.


This is an in-office role and will be based in our regional office location in São Paulo (Vila Olimpia), SP, Brazil.


Key job responsibilities

  1. Contribute to developing strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the long-range growth, implement new processes and develop standard operating procedures that fits within Amazon's mission to deliver the highest quality results to the customer.
  2. Recruit passive candidates and gauge candidate skill sets against open roles.
  3. Build and maintain network of potential candidates through proactive market research and on-going relationship management.
  4. Interview candidates within the framework of the position specification. Screen, interview and prepare an ideal candidate slate within an appropriate and consistent timeline.
  5. Work closely with Business, TA and HR leaders to influence and deliver a quality assessment and candidate experience through all aspects of the recruitment funnel.
  6. Lead and/or participate in cross-business/cross-company special projects and initiatives related to talent acquisition.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s Degree;
  • Corporate and or search firm recruiting experience including sourcing or full life cycle recruiting;
  • Experience building and utilizing a variety of sourcing plans and tools;
  • Experience using Contact Management System/Applicant Tracking System for sourcing, tracking and managing candidates;
  • Experience managing and prioritizing multiple searches, projects and client relationships;

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong client focus and commitment to continuous improvement; ability to proactively network and establish effective working relationships, continually seek new sourcing options, and develop creative approaches to delivering candidates to the customer;
  • Strong communication skills, organizational and client management skills;
  • Passion for and proven success creating and implementing successful diversity strategies;
  • Ability to execute recruiting strategy, including employer promotion in the marketplace, candidate management, diversity sourcing, and interview process; Ability to build and develop strong sourcing strategies through the use of various recruiting channels/platforms;
  • Possess strong analytical skills with ability to create, measure, and scale the right workflow between candidates, hiring managers, and the recruiting team;

title: Analista de Projetos (Desenvolvimento de Produtos)
description:
A Editora Opet nasceu em Curitiba no ano de 1993. Na época, ela era uma pequena unidade editorial responsável pela produção dos livros e apostilas utilizados pelos estudantes e professores do colégio e dos cursos técnicos oferecidos pelo Grupo Educacional Opet na capital paranaense.
A qualidade desses materiais didáticos chamou a atenção de outras escolas privadas e de redes públicas de ensino, que desejavam contar com recursos semelhantes em suas próprias salas de aula.
Diante desse interesse, a Editora Opet passou a oferecer seus serviços a outras instituições de ensino, o que levou a um aprimoramento dos materiais e à busca por recursos pedagógicos avançados. A equipe de autores, editores, revisores e artistas gráficos aumentou, assim como a percepção sobre as demandas da educação brasileira e o desejo de contribuir para um país melhor a partir da escola.
Já não se tratava apenas, então, de produzir livros, mas de pensar e oferecer algo mais, um sistema de ensino verdadeiramente transformador, com recursos pedagógicos e ferramentas tecnológicas capazes de encantar e promover o verdadeiro aprendizado.
Desse movimento nasceu o Sistema de Ensino Opet ? hoje, Opet Soluções Educacionais -, que assumiu como paradigma a chamada Educação Cidadã, uma educação pautada em valores como a ética, o conhecimento relevante, a cidadania, a sustentabilidade, a autonomia e a solidariedade.
Em 2015, quando já estava consolidada entre as grandes editoras educacionais do país, a Editora Opet adquiriu o Sefe ? Sistema Educacional Família e Escola, um sistema de ensino também fundado em Curitiba e de grande sucesso na educação pública. O paradigma do Sefe ? que tem seu mote no valor da relação entre família e escola para o sucesso da educação ? trouxe mais sensibilidade e qualidade ao olhar e ao trabalho da Editora Opet.
Hoje, a Editora Opet atua com dois selos educacionais: Opet Soluções Educacionais, dirigido às escolas privadas, e Sefe, voltado às escolas públicas. Juntos, os dois selos chegam a 340 mil estudantes e a dezenas de milhares de professores de 17 Estados e do Distrito Federal, que recebem livros, formações pedagógicas, coleções e ferramentas tecnológicas para uma educação humana, relevante e cidadã. Um trabalho que também propõe uma parceria de valor aos gestores ? diretores, mantenedores, secretários de Educação ? e também às famílias, que são convidadas a participar do processo educacional.
O departamento de Tecnologia Educacional da Editora Opet está procurando um profissional interessado, comprometido e que queira mergulhar no universo Educacional.
Suas atribuições serão:
Será responsável pelo planejamento, execução e acompanhamento de projetos de desenvolvimento de produtos educacionais, garantindo que os cronogramas, recursos e entregas estejam alinhados às metas estratégicas da editora. Atuará na interface entre as equipes de tecnologia, conteúdo e pedagógica, assegurando que os produtos sejam inovadores, escaláveis e adaptados às necessidades do mercado educacional.

  • Gerir o ciclo de vida de projetos de desenvolvimento de produtos, desde a concepção até a entrega.
  • Definir escopo, prazos e criticidade dos projetos, garantindo a execução conforme o cronograma.
  • Interagir com equipes multidisciplinares (tecnologia, conteúdo, design e comercial) para garantir entregas alinhadas.
  • Identificar riscos e implementar planos de ação para mitigar impactos no projeto.
  • Analisar requisitos dos produtos, garantindo alinhamento com as demandas do mercado e da área pedagógica.
  • Estabelecer processos ágeis (ex.: Scrum, Kanban) para o desenvolvimento de produtos educacionais.
  • Acompanhar indicadores e resultados dos produtos após o lançamento, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Conduzir testes e validações com usuários finais (professores e alunos).
  • Gerir documentação técnica e de produto.
  • Participar da pesquisa de mercado para identificar tendências e oportunidades de inovação em produtos educacionais.
Experiência Necessária
  • Experiência comprovada em gerenciamento de projetos e desenvolvimento de produtos, preferencialmente no setor educacional ou editorial.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência em coordenação de equipes multidisciplinares.
Competências Técnicas
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ex.: Jira, Trello, Monday).
  • Familiaridade com desenvolvimento de produtos digitais e integração de plataformas (LMS, sistemas de avaliação, etc.).
  • Capacidade de análise de dados para tomada de decisão e melhoria contínua.
Competências Comportamentais
  • Capacidade de liderança e resolução de conflitos.

  • Visão estratégica e orientação para resultados.

title: Procurement Manager - Logistics NA
description:

With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. Our strategy begins with a purpose that places consumers at the heart of everything we do: Brighten everyday life for all. Our goal is to deliver best-in-class performance with market-making, unmissably superior brands. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world. At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our collaborative, and flexible working environment. Our organizational ambition centers around creating workplaces that foster equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging across all aspects of our business. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

ABOUT PROCUREMENT

Part of the Supply Chain family, Procurement is responsible for over 30B Euro of material and services spend globally with more than 60,000 suppliers. Getting the right services and materials, sustainably sourced and ensuring responsible procurement is critical to ensuring our brands with purpose grow. Our teams work closely with the business to understand stakeholders needs, bring innovation to meet changing consumer, employees and customers needs, and drive financial value for Unilever through competitive buying. We’re at the forefront of digital procurement, bringing new tools and analytics to drive data-based decisions. Our strategy is ‘Procurement with Purpose’ and focuses on buying responsibly, buying better, and growing together with partners around the world. Our ambition is based on three key drivers: being Purpose-Led, Value-Driven, and Future-Fit.

Purpose:

The Procurement Manager for Logistics in North America will be responsible for supporting the sourcing strategy development and assisting with the procurement of transportation services for the US, Canada, and Mexico. This position is responsible for business partnering with logistics function at a market level to land relevant capabilities that drive service, value creation, and responsible sourcing in the markets. This role will partner with two peer managers to support the procurement of multiple modes of freight in the network.

Who You Are and What You'll Do

This role will support the buying activities of the North America network including but not limited to:

  1. Following the standard 7-step strategic procurement process from strategy alignment and market scans to supporting Request for Proposals and contract discussions to business approval, contract signing, and operational implementation.
  2. Support preparation of executive level briefs on the negotiation strategy for annual bids for review by the Global Head of Logistics Procurement and Chief Procurement Officer.
  3. Maintain market intelligence to forecast future cost structures with internal stakeholders in Logistics and Finance.
  4. Identify disruptive emerging technologies to create capacity or innovation for the business, e.g., autonomous trucking, paperless BOLs, API integration, etc.
  5. Support any North American logistics network redesign projects to identify capacity solutions and providers that provide the right end to end need for cost, capacity, and service.
  6. Business partnering to the Logistics operations team in the markets to deliver savings projects while achieving service level targets.
  7. Support Global benchmarking project work for Transportation to gain and maintain cost transparency and competitive buying for North America.
  8. Maintain productive relationships with external 3PL carrier partners, organizing strategic business reviews and joint business development plans with Strategic partners.
  9. Support the development and implementation of the North America Sustainability Roadmap to decarbonize Unilever’s carbon emissions by 2039.
  10. Develop opportunities to decouple the value chain for transportation with carriers and other external partners to drive competitive advantage and savings for Unilever.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  1. Bachelor’s Degree required with preference in Logistics, Supply Chain, or other Business field.
  2. Relevant Procurement or Logistics experience required, preferably in Consumer-Packaged Goods company.
  3. Knowledge and experience of the Strategic Procurement Process and application in Logistics.
  4. Understanding of Value Chain of transportation and demonstrated ability to extract costs via Should Cost models.
  5. Experience negotiating cost variables with transportation providers leading to successful outcomes.
  6. Awareness of transportation providers and market intelligence sources in North America.
  7. Proven abilities in stakeholder management, with an emphasis on listening and influencing.
  8. Experience working with enterprise level logistics systems, such as a Transportation or Yard.
  9. Fluency in English in written and verbal forms.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. ASCM/APICS certification in CLTD or CSCP
  2. CSCMP SCPro certification
  3. Formal negotiation training or experience
  4. SAP, Oracle TMS, JDA WMS, Jaggaer contracting, and PINC YMS experience are preferred

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, or any other basis protected by applicable law, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life. This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity.

Unilever is an organisation committed to equity, inclusion and diversity to drive our business results and create a better future, every day, for our diverse employees, global consumers, partners, and communities. title: Formação MCSA SQL Server 2016 Expert
description:
Curso Formação MCSA SQL Server 2016 Expert

Objetivo da Formação MCSA SQL Server 2016 Expert:

Autenticar e autorizar usuários

Este módulo abrange usuários, logins e modelos de segurança do SQL Server.

Atribuição de funções de banco de dados e servidor
Este módulo abrange funções de servidor fixas, funções de servidor definido pelo usuário, funções fixas de banco de dados e funções de banco de dados definido pelo usuário.

Autorizar os usuários para acessar recursos
Este módulo abrange a atribuição de permissões e permissões.

Auditoria e proteção de dados com criptografia
Este módulo aborda a auditoria do SQL Server.

Modelos de recuperação SQL Server
Este módulo descreve o conceito do log de transações e modelos de recuperação de SQL Server. Ele também introduz as diferentes estratégias de backup disponíveis com o SQL Server.

Restaurando bancos de dados do SQL Server
Este módulo descreve a restauração de bancos de dados.

Automatizando o gerenciamento do SQL Server
Este módulo descreve como usar o SQL Server Agent para automação. Ele também explica os benefícios de usar servidores mestre e alvo descentralizar a administração de automação.

Configurando a segurança para o SQL Server Agent
Este módulo descreve as considerações para a segurança do SQL Server Agent, incluindo as credenciais e as contas de proxy.

Módulo 10 ? Monitoramento do SQL Server com alertas e notificações
Este módulo aborda a configuração do database mail, alertas e notificações.

Introdução ao gerenciamento do SQL Server usando o PowerShell
Este módulo introduz o PowerShell do SQL Server.

Rastreamento de acesso ao SQL Server
Este módulo descreve como usar o SQL Profiler e procedimentos armazenados do rastreamento SQL para capturar informações sobre o SQL Server. O módulo também descreve como usar o Distributed Replay para capturar informações de rastreamento de vários servidores e como monitorar o bloqueio.

Monitoramento do SQL Server
Este módulo explica como usar exibições de gerenciamento distribuído para monitorar o SQL Server. Ele também descreve a configuração de coleta de dados e SQL Server Utility.

Módulo 14 ? Solucionando problemas de SQL Server
Este módulo explica o SQL Server, solução de problemas de metodologia e discute os problemas mais comuns que podem surgir quando se trabalha com sistemas de SQL Server.

Módulo 15 ? Importação e exportação de dados
Este módulo aborda o uso de assistentes de importação/exportação e explica como eles se relacionam com o SSIS. O módulo também apresenta BCP e BULK INSERT.

SQL Server 2016 componentes
Descreva a plataforma SQL Server, SQL Server serviços e opções de configuração do SQL Server.

Atualizando do SQL Server para o SQL Server 2016
Este módulo descreve como atualizar sua instalação atual do SQL Server para o SQL Server 2016.

Implantar o SQL Server na Microsoft Azure
Este módulo descreve as opções disponíveis para executar o SQL Server no Azure.

Trabalhando com bancos de dados
Este módulo descreve os bancos de dados do sistema pré-instalado, a estrutura física das bases de dados e as opções de configuração mais comuns relacionadas a eles.

Opções de armazenamento de banco de dados
No final deste módulo, você será capaz de descrever as opções de armazenamento de banco de dados.

Executar a manutenção de banco de dados
Este módulo abrange manutenção de banco de dados.

Descrever os principais recursos e componentes do SQL Server 2016.

- Descrever T-SQL, conjuntos e lógica de predicados.

- Escrever uma instrução SELECT em uma única tabela.

- Escrever uma instrução SELECT de várias tabelas.

- Escrever instruções SELECT com filtragem e classificação.

- Descrever como o SQL Server usa tipos de dados.

- Escrever instruções DML.

- Escrever consultas que usam funções do SQL Server.

- Escrever consultas que agregam dados.

- Criar e implementar vistas e funções com valores de tabela.

- Utilizar operadores para combinar os resultados da consulta.

- Escrever consultas que usam ranking, offset e agregação.

- Transformar dados implementando pivô, unpivot, rollup e cube.

- Criar e implementar procedimentos armazenados.

- Adicionar construções de programação como variáveis, condições e loops ao código T-SQL.

- Descrever designs avançados de tabelas.

- Assegurar integridade dos dados através de Constraints.

- Descrever índices, incluindo índices do tipo Optimized e Columnstore.

- Projetar e implementar Views.

- Projetar e implementar Stored Procedures.

- Projetar e implementar funções definidas pelo usuário.

- Responder à manipulação de dados usando Triggers.

- Criar e implementar In-Memory Tables.

- Armazenar e consultar dados XML.

The Business Area Controlling Maintenance & Cloud Team is responsible for actively managing the Topline for SAP’s Cloud & Maintenance business for 6 of SAP regions (EMEA North, EMEA South, MEE, APJ, NA and LAC). The team is responsible for the implementation and optimization of planning models as well as forecast and actual analyses covering all market units within the regional scope. In this role, you will contribute to steering of SAP’s biggest revenue stream.

Preferred skills

  • Highly experienced on SAP system and processes would be a significant strength.

  • Proven ability to drive business transformation and execution against ambitious milestones.
  • Knowledge and/or experience of Maintenance Business Model would be an advantage.

WORK EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum 4 to 5 years professional work experience with a strong focus on controlling and/or accounting, preferably with a current role at an MU/Regional level across various LOBs. Ideally, some knowledge in maintenance revenue models would be a plus (i.e. Point-In-Time revenue stream).

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Job Description

The Digital and IT Site Leader is responsible for defining and implementing the site’s digital master plan, aligning it with essential business needs. Define and Drive the Digital Master Plan for the Site (30% of capacity)

  • Actively participate as a member of the site leadership team.
  • Develop the digital master plan for the site in line with the Business Unit (BU) and the site’s compelling business need.
  • Ensure the master plan includes strategic interventions to optimize data architecture, enabling predictive analytics and value acceleration. Coach teams on the successful delivery of these programs/projects.
  • Reflect the digital master plan in the portfolio tool (1PT) to track progress and outcomes.
  • Lead regular digital portfolio reviews with key stakeholders from the site, central BU organization, and Global Business Services (GBS).
  • Collaborate with GBS service line leaders/Single Points of Contact (SPOCs) to achieve the site’s operational targets, drive business growth and value, and enable the progression of the Integrated Work System (IWS) framework's digital pillar.

  • Act as a thought leader and provide critical input to the master plan to ensure outcomes are achieved.
  • Ensure alignment with P&G’s “Smart from the Start” strategy for site expansion projects.

  • Conduct at least one digital pilot per year leveraging P&G Data Architecture, AI, and Manufacturing Data Flow (MDF) architecture, bringing AI use cases to life to deliver business value.

Ensure Operational Excellence and IT Controls - Audits Ready Every Day (20% of capacity)

Manage the Site Data and Technology Budget (10% of capacity)

About P&G:

P&G is the largest consumer packaged goods company in the world. We have operations in over 75 countries, with 65 trusted brands that improve lives for 5 billion consumers worldwide. This brings many advantages, including the opportunity for our employees to enjoy a diverse and rewarding lifelong career filled with new and exciting challenges.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. Our mission of Equality and Inclusion is: “Everyone valued. Everyone included. Everyone performing at their peak”.

We seek the most diverse talent so that we always know how to innovate to exceed the expectations of our consumers. We offer meaningful challenges from day one and effective and constant training. Thus, we bring to bear the strengths of our employees and develop them to become phenomenal leaders, reaching the highest levels of management. Working with us is the best opportunity to do what you love, with constant challenges and to be recognized for its results. More than that, it's the ideal opportunity to help us touch and improve billions of lives in our world.

For over 175 years, we have built some of the world’s most successful brands, including Always, Ariel, Aussie, Clearblue, Downy, Gillette, Head and Shoulders, Oral-B, Pampers, Pantene and Vick.

Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

The group's key figures are approximately: Turnover of 6.5 billion euros, more than 940 laboratories in 62 countries and around 62,000 employees.

SUMMARY OF POSITION AND OBJECTIVES:

The Release Manager role will be responsible for deploying builds across the environment, on-boarding new environment , Handling transversal projects and create release management related document and share release plan with the stakeholders

  • Participate in CAB meetings to present Production changes (RFCs)

  • Weekly Release Reporting with Program release manager.
  • Own and continually improve the release process by documenting release issues and developing plans to improve processes, able to recommend continuous improvements viz: automation .
  • Comfortable in interacting with people across hierarchical levels for smooth project execution. Enjoys managing complex projects involving challenges.
Qualifications

  • English Language is mandatory to collaborate in a global environment, including writing, speaking and presenting.

  • Good understanding of cloud deployment, preferably Azure and Agile practice
  • Knowledge on Deployment tool like Octopus

  • Document Management for adhere to Audit Compliance process is an added advantage
  • 4 to 5 years of relevant release and deployment management experience

  • Strong in troubleshooting and organizational skills and ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.

Executivo de Vendas - PJBank

O setor comercial é um dos nossos principais pontos de contato com as pessoas. É quem fecha negócios e apresenta nossas soluções e mostra quem somos.

Por isso, é importante estar sempre atualizado sobre o mundo da tecnologia e gestão de empresas e ser capaz de compreender e se adequar a cada especificidade regional, já que irá falar com pessoas do país inteiro.

Os profissionais dessa área devem entender e estar integrados com as estratégias de marketing e vendas, atuando ativamente na jornada no cliente, mostrando e vivendo nossos valores.

Esteja pronto para lidar com muitos dados, colaborar e inovar muito!

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  1. Visitar clientes;
  2. Agendar reuniões junto a decisores e influenciadores;
  3. Prospectar e qualificar leads;
  4. Auto gerenciar funil de vendas, processamentos e conversões;
  5. Atender de forma rápida e consultiva, compreender a demanda e necessidades de cada potencial cliente;
  6. Manter a negociação com os clientes aquecida e atualizada;
  7. Formalizar a proposta;
  8. Acompanhar e atualizar o histórico das negociações no CRM;
  9. Garantir a manutenção da carteira de clientes;
  10. Fornecer insights com as objeções levantadas ao gestor da área.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  1. Boa experiência em vendas externas;
  2. Experiência com CRM de vendas;
  3. Empatia e ótima comunicação verbal e escrita;
  4. Autonomia, proatividade e organização;
  5. Focado em resultados;
  6. Boas técnicas de negociação;
  7. Possuir veículo próprio;
  8. Disponibilidade para viagens.

Disponibilidade para atuação em modelo híbrido 3x2 e viagens: 3 dias presenciais no escritório de Campinas/SP ou Barueri/SP e 2 dias em home office.

Diferenciais:

  1. Conhecimento em meios de pagamento e operações financeiras (experiência em PJ bancária desejável) ou atuação com vendas em Saas;
  2. Habilidade em vendas complexas e ciclos de vendas longo;
  3. Experiência comprovada em vendas em canais.

Fazendo parte do time, você terá SuperBenefícios como:

  • Flexibilidade de horário: Podemos sempre nos adaptar às mudanças do dia a dia, o importante mesmo é sempre alcançar o objetivo.
  • Ajuda de custo para os dias em home office: A gente dá o suporte necessário para que você possa trabalhar no conforto do seu lar, em dias de home office.
  • Ifoof Benefícios Flexíveis (VA + VR): Transformar o mundo dá uma fome, né?! E é claro que o nosso recheado VA e VR não podem ficar de fora dessa missão.
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico: A saúde sempre em primeiro lugar, para você e seus dependentes.
  • Apoio aos pais: Se tornar mãe ou pai é algo espetacular, e queremos participar deste grande momento com você. Por isso, além do auxílio creche, temos também licença-parental (maternidade e paternidade) estendida.
  • Saúde e Bem-estar: Parceria com o Gympass e auxílio farmácia.
  • Treinamentos e educação: Temos parcerias com escolas e universidades e oferecemos treinamentos EaD gratuitos.

title: Operador Técnico - Farmoquímica (Upstream)
description:
Job description

Somos uma empresa farmacêutica brasileira que há mais de 65 anos trata da vida. Com o propósito de "transformar conhecimento em saúde pra sua vida", construímos nossa história com ousadia, inovação e espírito visionário.

Nossa razão de existir é promover saúde de alta qualidade para que as pessoas possam aproveitar cada momento. Temos um amplo portfólio de medicamentos de diversas especialidades, como ginecologia, oncologia e cardiologia, para atender os pacientes em sua integralidade e individualidade, com formulações eficientes e inovadoras. São mais de 100 marcas em mais de 200 apresentações.

Queremos que aqui você encontre o seu lugar! Somos considerados um excelente lugar para se trabalhar, segundo o GPTW. Estabelecemos relações de transparência e confiança com nossos mais de 3 mil colaboradores e estimulamos a mobilidade como ferramenta de desenvolvimento profissional. A saúde e bem-estar norteiam nossas decisões.

#PorqueSeTratadaVida


Main responsibilities

No dia a dia você irá:

  1. Organizar o processo produtivo de lotes, seguindo o roteiro de execução de produção e análise de equipamentos e materiais, visando entregar os produtos dentro dos padrões de qualidade no prazo proposto;
  2. Zelar pela conservação e calibração dos equipamentos, bem como pela conservação da infraestrutura (prédio) de produção;
  3. Responsável pela revisão de procedimentos, técnicas de fabricação e formulários de registros (Logbooks), visando identificar os erros e providenciar as correções necessárias dentro das normas de boas práticas de fabricação;
  4. Certificar-se de que os procedimentos operacionais estejam atualizados e em consenso com a rotina de execução da produção;
  5. Organizar os documentos impressos dentro das áreas produtivas, zelando pela atualidade da revisão;
  6. Responsável por preencher e elaborar os relatórios de desvios de qualidade na produção;
  7. Elaborar e acompanhar as ações de controle de mudanças (relacionados a processo produtivo, área de produção, equipamentos etc.), que deverão ser enviados ao controle de qualidade;
  8. Treinar e capacitar novos colaboradores na operação prática dos equipamentos, execução do processo, métodos de trabalho e rotinas de trabalho da área;
  9. Conduzir processo de compra de materiais auxiliares desde a elaboração de requisições de compras, cadastramento de itens ou contato com o fornecedor;
  10. Assegurar o envio das amostras de controle de processo ao controle da qualidade, conforme cronograma acordado entre as áreas.

Requirements and skills

Para participar do nosso processo:

  1. Curso técnico completo ou graduação em andamento nos cursos de farmácia, biotecnologia, biologia, engenharias ou áreas correlatas;
  2. Vivência em cultivo bacteriano e operação de biorreatores, preparo de meio de cultura e manipulação asséptica em fluxo laminar no segmento farmacêutico;
  3. Experiência em áreas produtivas da indústria farmacêutica, com foco em processos biotecnológicos.

Será um diferencial se tiver:

  1. Experiência em elaboração de documentação técnica.
  2. Experiência em operação de biorreatores em escala industrial.
  3. Graduação completa/ pós graduação em andamento.

Additional information

+ Informações

Local de trabalho (Base): Embu das Artes

Horário: 6x2/6x3 – 2º Turno (14h às 22h20)

Benefícios pra você!

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Medicamentos Libbs - 100%;
  • Convênio Farmácia – Vidalink;
  • PPR - Programa de Participação dos Lucros e Resultados da companhia;

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores!   • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of work experience in a technical role (e.g., software engineering, solutions consultant, etc.) or equivalent technical experience.
  • Experience speaking at technology conferences, blogging/writing technical articles with an existing follower base, or contributing to a popular open source project.
  • Experience in the areas of Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence or GenAI, including ability to guide developers on the use of these technologies.
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese and English fluently to support the local and global developer community.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in coding/engineering beneficial to the technical domain.
  • Ability to take ownership of solutions and exert influence without authority.
  • Ability to work globally and collaboratively in a team environment, be diplomatic, and influence technical practitioners, stakeholders, and globally distributed teams.
  • Ability to share technical knowledge and information with others.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate in Spanish fluently to support the community in the LATAM region.

About the job

Passionate people are everywhere at Google. In Developer Relations, we get excited to collaborate and connect with the communities that love technology as much as we do. Part community manager and part developer advocate, Developer Relations Engineers collaborate with developers at conferences and online, and advocate for developers interests internally at Google. Not afraid to be hands-on, you write sample code and client libraries as well as participate in developer forums and support queues to troubleshoot and debug coding problems developers encounter. Internally, you work with product engineering teams to improve our products by conveying feedback from developers, reviewing API designs and testing new features. Chrome, Android, App Engine, HTML5 as well as our core Google Apps and Ads APIs are just some of the platforms you promote and support.
With your technical expertise, you drive strategy around fostering a community of developers who work with Google technologies. An ardent advocate for these developers, you represent their voice internally to our Product Managers and serve as their Google support in application development and technology implementation.

As a Cloud Developer Relations Engineer, you’ll join a team of Practitioners that empathize deeply with external technical communities, and advocate on their behalf to the Google Cloud Product and Engineering teams, ensuring that our products are built to meet the community's needs and that they provide the best possible user and developer experiences. You’ll work to raise awareness of Cloud technologies and methodologies within our technical communities through enablement and inspiration, and you’ll drive strategy around Google Developer Relations efforts for specific communities and products.

Responsibilities

  • Advocate for the community internally and influence Google Cloud product strategy by working with cross-functional teams. Support an inclusive work environment.
  • Synthesize feedback in order to drive continuous improvement to Google Cloud Platform products and to the overall experience of the platform by technical practitioners.
  • Participate in technical communities as a practitioner having, or developing, deep understanding of that community’s needs. Build and foster an external community ecosystem of influencers, meetups, experts that amplify messages and extend the reach.
  • Represent the needs of relevant technical communities throughout the entire product lifecycle, including input on design discussions, customer zero testing, launch, post-launch updates.
  • Work with Product and Engineering teams to define product strategies and to craft narratives around new products and features.

title: Project Engineer
description:
The Project Engineer position is responsible for assisting and supporting Senior Project Managers and Project Directors in representing Roeslein & Associates in all matters involving the prospecting for and the proposing, negotiating, securing, and implementation of our projects and will serve as the customer's single point of interface throughout each of his/her projects.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist Business Development in developing estimates and schedule for proposals; presenting proposals to existing and potential customers; and developing and maintaining existing customer relationships; and assist Business Development in developing new customer relationships.
  • Assist Project Managers responsible for customer management and communication, including change orders, engineering details, invoicing, and project schedule updates.
  • Assist Project Managers responsible for project financials, including reviewing job cost details, reviewing actuals vs. estimated costs, invoicing, and monthly projections.
  • Assist Project Managers responsible for project team management and communication, including kick-off meetings, project progress meetings, and lessons learned.
  • Prepare all proposal documents for all RFQs (proposal, estimate, schedule, clarifications & exceptions, etc). Estimates and proposals must meet client RFQ requirements for format and content.
  • Manage, interpret and enforce existing customer contracts and terms of all project subcontracts.
  • Establish a complete and detailed project schedule for each project; a thoroughly documented scope of work for the project; and a project budget in accordance with Roeslein’s cost accounting system.
  • Plan for and secure any required subcontractors, including (but not limited to) engineers, consultants, fabricators, electrical and mechanical contractors, clerks, schedulers, administrative support, etc.
  • Implement bidding process for project subcontractors to obtain the most competitive prices.
  • Assist with negotiation and authorization of all terms and conditions of project subcontracts, and authorize subcontract changes.
  • Oversee, control and authorize all project-related expenditures.
  • Provide monthly project cost projections as compared with the project’s estimated budget; and monthly reports of project cost projections.
  • Present the contracted scope of work to the project team and ensure complete understanding and acceptance of responsibilities.
  • Provide thorough communication with the project team.
  • Travel domestically and internationally ranging from 10-50% per year and up to four (4) weeks duration.

OTHERS DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Promote a positive working environment in order to achieve the organization’s goals.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Work is performed in an office and uncontrolled atmosphere. Exposure to harsh conditions—such as: dust, fumes, chemicals, hazardous materials, noise, and varying weather and temperatures—for short periods of time is possible. Must be able to travel to jobsites both domestically and internationally; living accommodations in some foreign assignments may not meet expected U.S. standards. All employees are required to follow safety standards and wear all personal protective equipment in designated areas.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to safely and successfully perform the essential responsibilities and functions of a Project Manager and are not meant to be all-inclusive. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential responsibilities and functions of the job.

KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering.
  • Courses in the area of Project Management.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

OTHER DESIRABLE ATTRIBUTES:

  • It is preferred a minimum of Three (3) years of professional experience in a technically related field is required. It is strongly preferred that Two (2) years of that experience be as a Project Engineer.
  • A certified Project Management Professional (PMP) is preferred.
  • Demonstrated history of in strategic and tactical goal setting and attainment.
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, and excellent presentation skills are required.
  • Strong organization, leadership, negotiation, and delegation skills are required.
  • Strong financial background including operations budget development, cost control, and capital spending justification.
  • Working knowledge of contract laws, jobsite safety procedures, and purchasing practices.
  • Specific estimating skills for engineering, construction management, and mechanical/electrical construction services is a must.
  • Working knowledge of common scheduling concepts such as CPM, PERT, Gantt charts, resource loading, etc.
  • Skilled in the use of scheduling software tools and must be able to create schedule reports for all audiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills are required.
  • Computer skills and an in-depth knowledge of Microsoft Windows based programs are required.
  • Requires effective time management skills, personal conduct, and change management abilities.
  • Must have a valid driver license.
  • Ability to effectively interact with co-workers, clients, vendors, and other business contacts.
  • Must comply with Roeslein & Associate’s core values for the safe and efficient operation of the business and maintain sound relationships among and with employees.

This is an in-person position, and applicants must be comfortable commuting to Arujá/SP. The role is primarily office-based, however, occasional travel to jobsites both domestically and internationally may be required.

Join to apply for the Graduate Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

The role of a Customer Success Manager at Canonical
Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective to reduce risk and churn, facilitate the adoption of new products or services and support expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. Through a clear understanding of their customer's objectives, the CSM can activate a large range of internal and external capabilities to alleviate any pain point, align expectations, as well as help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.
We are growing our Customer Success team to continue offering thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open source infrastructure and applications.
This role is a first step in the CSM organisation. Although you will primarily focus on the Tech segment, including the store customers, you will also have a portfolio assigned. Ubuntu is chosen by thousands of new users every month. Our responsibility is to ensure the best user experience for them through problem-solving, onboarding, enablement and value realisation all the way to success. Collaborating with other teams and participating in campaign efforts, you will connect with a diverse set of users of Canonical products and identify our future champions.
Location: This role will be based remotely worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • A strong focus on supporting customers by finding solutions to ticket requests.
  • Enrich documentation about problem solving, Q&A, onboarding materials.
  • Drive campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
  • Identify high potential as well as high risk customers from newly onboarded users or customers
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Engage with your portfolio of customers to ensure risk identification
  • Collect feedback from customers and format them for review by the product team
What we are looking for in you
  • Customer-facing experience
  • An empathetic individual with a natural drive to help others
  • Passion for technology, infrastructure and Ubuntu in particular is a must
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Strong organisational skills, ability to structure and constantly update documentation
  • A team player capable of interacting with all departments internally
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job description

O QUE É SER MYRA?

É provocar a mudança com menos burocracia e mais coragem.

Ser Myra é saber ouvir e ser ouvido. É cuidar uns dos outros e cuidar do cliente. É entender que o aprendizado é a melhor parte da jornada. E é sempre querer saber mais. É transformar dados em conhecimento e com ele em mãos mudar o mundo.

Main responsibilities

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  1. Garantir a qualidade dos dados e das integrações de diversas fontes;

  3. Comunicar os resultados de suas análises de forma envolvente, clara e eficaz para diversos stakeholders;
  4. Estar atualizado com as novas tecnologias e metodologias;
  5. Coletar e integrar dados de diferentes fontes, garantindo a consistência e a precisão das informações;

  11. Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas como marketing, vendas e finanças;
  12. Monitorar e garantir o funcionamento adequado das ferramentas e sistemas de BI.

*Para desempenhar bem essas atividades, um Analista de BI deve dominar ferramentas de visualização de dados e linguagens de programação, como Python e SQL. Além disso, é essencial ter uma orientação para negócios para alinhar as análises com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa.

Requisitos e qualificações

Superior Completo ou Cursando nas áreas de Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística e áreas correlatas.

Domínio dos requisitos abaixo:

  1. Análise de Dados: Capacidade de interpretar grandes volumes de dados e extrair insights valiosos.
  2. Conhecimento em Ferramentas de BI: Proficiência no uso do Power BI.
  3. Habilidades de Programação: Conhecimento em linguagens de programação como SQL e Integration Services (SSIS).
  4. Compreensão de Negócios: Entendimento das operações, estratégias e objetivos do negócio.

  7. Pensamento Crítico: Capacidade de avaliar informações de forma lógica.
  8. Atenção aos Detalhes: Foco em detalhes para garantir a precisão e a qualidade dos dados analisados.
  9. Trabalho em Equipe: Habilidade para colaborar com diferentes equipes e departamentos.
  10. Adaptabilidade e Aprendizado Contínuo: Flexibilidade para se adaptar a novas tecnologias e métodos.

O Atacadão é a única rede atacadista alimentar presente em todos os estados do Brasil, com 415 pontos de operação, sendo 379 lojas de autosserviço e 36 atacados de entrega e centros de distribuição, que juntos alcançam 95% dos 5.570 municípios do país.

Job Summary

The Application Specialist is an experienced technical professional that provides support to IFF Pharma Solutions products and applications in Brazil, supporting all LATAM lab activity needed. He/She manages the technical relationship with specific pharmaceutical and dietary supplement customers in support of growing the business and developing a robust pipeline of opportunities.

The Pharma Solutions business will be taking on its next chapter of growth as a trusted partner for the pharmaceutical industry with the announcement to sell Pharma Solutions to Roquette. This move will position Pharma Solutions to expand its industry leadership through continued investment in innovation to meet the evolving needs of pharmaceutical manufacturers and developers worldwide. The sale is presently expected to close in the first half of 2025, pending regulatory approvals and other closing conditions. The Pharma Solutions business unit will remain a part of IFF until close and, at such time, it will transition to Roquette. In applying for this position, you acknowledge your awareness that the position is a part of the Pharma Solutions business unit and has been identified to transition to Roquette.

Responsibilities:

Technical Expertise on Established Products and Applications:

  • Contribute to/lead creative application approaches utilizing IFF’s excipients via generation of ideas and concepts to meet current and anticipated customer needs and to offer strong alternatives to competitive products.
  • Be the technical expert in IFF’s Pharmaceutical and Dietary Supplement excipient products Portfolio and its applications, providing hands-on/classroom training to Customers, Sales, Marketing, and Distributors, as appropriate. Publish conference posters, papers, and articles.
  • Support the commercialization of new technologies and/or products through voice-of-customer and application/customer trials.
  • Develop product data, applications, value-in-use information, product literature, and sales presentations.
  • Evaluate, develop data for, and assist in introducing new products.
  • Perform failure analysis and determine root cause/corrective action.

Strategic Market Support:

  • Collaborate with Strategic and Field Marketing in identifying global trends that could result in new opportunities or risks for IFF Pharma Solutions and translate those into appropriate application or product concepts.
  • Identify unmet customer and industry needs to accelerate growth such as specific technical support and services.
  • Effectively share learnings gained with other application, regional, and global teams.

Leadership:

  • Work closely with Marketing, Sales, and Distributors to ensure high-quality knowledge of our products and applications are communicated via training and demonstrations.
  • Act as a member of the global IFF Applications team to communicate regularly around successful Application projects and leverage learnings from other regions.

Project Management:

  • Develop and manage self-initiated or assigned Application/R&D projects and Customer Technical Service Requests (TSRs), and liaise with other Regional Labs to ensure timely completion and appropriate prioritization in alignment with Business needs.
  • Design experiments and testing protocols, and work with regional labs to coordinate bench work to support project goals.
  • Write Technical Reports and ensure confidential information is properly safeguarded throughout the course of project work.
  • Contribute to maintaining, improving, and advancing technical capabilities in line with current and future business needs and developments.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or Life Sciences is required.
  • 5-10 years of Pharmaceutical formulation and technical service or product development experience, which should include hands-on experience with formulating tablets, capsules, and/or gummies with experience in lab to pilot-scale blending, granulation, tableting, coating, and similar processes. Must be able to demonstrate practical familiarity with relevant equipment such as rotary tablet machines, fluid-bed granulator/coaters, encapsulation machines, gummy depositing equipment, and film coating equipment.
  • Highly collaborative and an effective communicator.
  • Skilled at building relationships and adapting messages for diverse audiences.
  • Dedicated to addressing customer needs, delivering solutions that meet customer expectations, and skilled in managing complexity.
  • Demonstrates decisive execution capabilities.
  • Advanced competency in science-based innovation.
  • Ability to fuse technical competency with the commercial aspects of the business.
  • Can balance the interests of multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • A willingness to travel if needed (20%).

Preferred Experience:

  • Demonstration of ability to lead/manage a product from R&D to manufacturing.
  • A broad overview of the technical/regulatory requirements and trends for the pharmaceutical industry.
  • A good understanding of related functional areas of a pharmaceutical company (e.g., analytical, clinical trials, production, QA, regulatory affairs).
  • Familiarity with the Dietary Supplement industry is preferred.

Preferred Education:

  • An MBA or MS/PhD in a relevant discipline, such as Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or Life Sciences, is strongly preferred.
  • English intermediate is needed.

Claro que, desde a sua primeira unidade, muita coisa mudou, mas a filosofia de trabalho continua a mesma: entendemos as pessoas, suas necessidades, evoluções, sua relação com a moda e as tendências, e traduzimos isso em uma experiência vibrante e completa. Esse é o nosso jeito de criar combinações para impulsionar e inspirar o pertencimento de cada pessoa.

A gente se encontra na C&A. Por aqui, acreditamos que nós podemos impactar positivamente as pessoas para que sejam o que desejam ser por meio da moda. Cada associada e associado traz consigo a alegria, a vibração e a energia para transformar o varejo e a moda no Brasil. Somos muitos e únicos, cada um trabalhando para dar vida ao nosso propósito. Além disso, há experiências que só a C&A pode oferecer: ambiente leve, informal e divertido; valores e compromissos inegociáveis para a sociedade; desenvolvimento profissional no varejo; e conexão com uma marca de renome e que entrega resultados consistentes. Nós vestimos as mudanças! Esse é o nosso DNA!

Senior Design System Designer - SAP Concur

At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. How? Join SAP Concur’s Design Systems team and help shape the future of scalable, accessible enterprise experiences. Move beyond maintaining a component library — architect how global teams design, build, and innovate across multiple SAP product areas.
You’ll create foundational patterns and practices that empower product teams worldwide to deliver exceptional experiences, improving how people travel, work, and manage expenses.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

In this role, you will:

  • Shape and grow a multi-platform design system used by millions globally.
  • Design foundational components, patterns, and floorplans that streamline complex enterprise experiences.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration with designers, engineers, and product managers worldwide.
  • Champion inclusive, accessible, and human-centered design practices at every level.
  • Mentor teams to create with quality, speed, and purpose while promoting design system best practices.
  • Analyze system usage and feedback (both quantitative and qualitative) to guide continuous improvements.
  • Educate and advocate across the organization to promote system adoption and scale impact.
  • Deliver measurable impact by simplifying complex systems, making them intuitive, empowering, and accessible for users everywhere.

  • Design System Leadership: Develop, evolve, and maintain a scalable, enterprise-grade design system supporting multiple products and platforms.
  • Component, Pattern, and Floorplan Design: Specify reusable UI components, UX patterns, and page-level floorplans with deep documentation and accessibility baked in.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with global designers, framework developers, product managers, and stakeholders to ensure smooth system implementation.
  • Accessibility and Inclusivity: Embed WCAG accessibility standards and inclusive design principles throughout every system element.
  • Education and Evangelism: Create training, documentation, workshops, and internal communication to increase system literacy and adoption.
  • Data-Driven Continuous Improvement: Evaluate feedback and usage data to prioritize and deliver high-impact system enhancements.
  • Mentorship and Support: Guide designers in system thinking, provide hands-on support for product teams, and cultivate a culture of design excellence.
  • Quality and Standards Stewardship: Maintain the highest quality standards for system assets and ensure consistent, scalable UX across SAP Concur platforms.

WHAT YOU BRING:

  • Proven experience building, evolving, and scaling enterprise-grade design systems across web and mobile platforms.
  • Deep systems thinking and expertise in designing scalable UI/UX foundations for complex products.
  • Strong collaboration skills working across global, multidisciplinary teams.
  • Expertise specifying and documenting components and patterns within Figma (or equivalent tools).
  • Deep commitment to accessibility (WCAG 2.1/2.2) and inclusive design.

KEY QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strong UX/UI Design Experience, with significant experience focused on design systems for enterprise environments
  • Figma Mastery: Expert in developing and managing scalable component libraries
  • Impactful System Portfolio: A portfolio or demo showcasing your design system work isrequired for consideration

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE TO HAVE):

  • Experience supporting large-scale, multi-product design systems in a global organization.
  • Passion for creating accessible, user-friendly solutions that serve diverse audiences.
  • Strong mentorship and coaching experience with junior or early-career designers.
  • Skilled at solving ambiguous, complex problems and turning them into clear, actionable goals.
  • Familiarity with technical constraints for web and mobile development across enterprise platforms.

Help us drive the future of enterprise UX by making complex systems simple, intuitive, and empowering — at global scale.

title: Senior Audit Manager, FinCrime (LACC)
description:
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by Crypto, ultimately contributing to every individual's freedom.

OKX began as a crypto exchange giving millions of people access to crypto trading and over time becoming among the largest platforms in the world. In recent years, we have developed one of the most connected Web3 wallets used by millions to access decentralized crypto applications (dApps).

OKX is a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets on a reliable platform that seamlessly connects with global banking and payments. In the last year, OKX has expanded into new markets including Australia, Brazil, Netherlands, Singapore and Turkey, with plans to launch in the US, Belgium and the UAE.

We are deeply committed to shaping a fairer, more transparent and accessible society through blockchain technology. This is why we publish proof of reserves monthly, and continue to ship new innovative security features.

About the Opportunity:

The Senior Audit Manager, FinCrime (LACC) will manage the internal audit function for financial crimes, including Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF), sanctions compliance, fraud prevention, and other financial crime-related activities. This role ensures that the organization's financial crime risk management and compliance frameworks are robust, effective, and aligned with regulatory expectations.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and implement the annual audit plan for financial crimes, ensuring alignment with the organization's strategic goals and regulatory requirements.
  • Advise senior management on financial crime-related risks, control gaps, and regulatory trends.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for financial crimes audit, providing strategic insights and guidance.
2. Audit Execution
  • Lead end-to-end audits covering AML/CTF, sanctions compliance, fraud detection, and other financial crime programs.
  • Assess the effectiveness of policies, procedures, controls, and systems designed to mitigate financial crime risks.
  • Monitor compliance with local and global regulatory requirements (e.g., AML, FATF, OFAC sanctions, etc.).
  • Ensure that audits are conducted efficiently, with clear and actionable recommendations provided to management.
3. Team Management
  • Foster and contribute to a culture of collaboration, excellence, and continuous improvement within the audit team.
  • Coordinate with colleagues located globally, as well the potential to manage performance of small teams to ensure the delivery of high-quality audit reports.
4. Stakeholder Management
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including Compliance,Risk Management, Legal, and external regulators.
  • Participate in governance forums, presenting audit findings and updates related to financial crimes risk.
  • Provide proactive insights into emerging financial crime risks and regulatory changes.
5. Regulatory and Industry Knowledge
  • Stay up to date with regulatory developments, industry best practices, and emerging threats in financial crime risk management.
  • Ensure the organization's financial crime audit approach aligns with regulatory expectations and global standards.
6. Reporting
  • Prepare and deliver comprehensive, timely, and accurate audit work papers and reports to senior management and the Audit Committee.
  • Track and validate the remediation of audit findings to ensure timely resolution.
What We're Looking For:

Experience: Strong experience (8+ years) in internal audit, including leadership roles in Financial Crimes at a leading global financial institution, fintech, or Big 4 firm. Experience in crypto, digital assets, or blockchain is a plus..

Expertise: Deep knowledge of AML, CTF, and sanctions regulatory expectations for financial services, and cutting-edge audit methodologies. Familiarity with data analytics and emerging audit technologies is highly desirable

Leadership: Proven ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Communication: Exceptional ability to articulate complex ideas to diverse audiences, including regulators and senior leadership

Certifications: ACAMS required.CPA, CIA, or similar credentials are also preferred. Advanced certifications (e.g., CISA, CFA) are a plus.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. Law degree or equivalent preferred.
